mapper.sql: SELECT rt.id AS token_id, rt.user_id, rt.family_id, rt.token_hash, rt.expires_at, rt.family_expires_at, rt.revoked_at, rt.revoked_reason, rt.replaced_by_id, rt.last_used_at, u.email, u.display_name, u.role, u.status, u.token_version, u.created_at AS user_created_at FROM refresh_token rt JOIN app_user u ON u.id = rt.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (user_id, family_id, token_hash, expires_at, family_expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{familyId}, #{tokenHash}, #{familyExpiresAt}, #{familyExpiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET last_used_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WHERE rt.token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE OF rt
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), revoked_reason = 'ROTATED', replaced_by_id = #{replacedBy}, last_used_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
